diagnosis: Before GPS handover, ICP progress is about 10 m ahead of GPS route progress. Exit guidance reads the post-portal right-hand bend using that progress, turning before the true position reaches that part of the route.
change: Before GPS rejoin, cap the route heading reference segment to end at the surveyed exit. Existing GPS handover then tracks the bend using GPS position.

new_regressions: post-portal bend must not change pre-GPS exit heading on drifted progress
original saved-map exit remains bounded at progress errors up to 20 m
obstacle may still force a checked avoidance turn with bounded exit heading

limitations: Fixed-state original-cloud comparison; exact worker odometry and clock inputs were not recorded.
The changed target has not been validated in a new vehicle drive.
Offsets are measured from saved R1; painted white-line position is not recorded as ground truth.
GPS becomes available after the tunnel; pre-return longitudinal drift is inferred from the first returned GPS samples.
Same-input/same-prior-state LiDAR comparisons do not simulate the changed vehicle trajectory.
No live ROS control node or vehicle was started; real driving validation remains.
